body: MAINLINE-008 filed. Fifteen candidates (13 QUESTIONABLE, CNT-yarn and graphene PROJECTION) are compared at equal face mass against P2-A, P2-C, P2-K and P2-E, with rho, E, compressive strength and source per candidate, E/rho and sigma_c/rho, and SF_b, SF_y and gap per row using the brief's first-order tf<<d scaling. Ranked by least SF in P2-E: SiC 1.212, CNT-yarn PROJECTION 1.178, graphene PROJECTION 0.917; best available after SiC are M55J quasi-isotropic 0.754 (E/rho limits, factor 1.325) and beryllium S-200F 0.582 (sigma_c/rho limits, factor 1.719). Sixteen pins verified; the 6061 candidate reproduces the pinned rows exactly. Brittle-face, QI-estimate and omitted-mode objections are NFI rows. Starting MAINLINE-008b now, no ruling needed.
